content: Official pricing pages confirm football-data.org Free provides 12 competitions, fixtures, delayed scores/schedules, league tables, and 10 calls/minute. API-Football currently advertises 100 requests/day and all endpoints with free-season limits. Because coverage and season availability vary, the product should retain runtime coverage checks, endpoint budgets, manual odds as the default, and visible limited-data states instead of assuming injuries or odds are consistently usable.
